messages:
deploybot: preflight-eval: release/2026-03-20 failed gate (prompt-suite). Delta +3.6% hallucination rate on summarizer prompts. blocking promotion. See /eval/221987 for details :warning:
michelle: saw this in the dashboard too. regression concentrated on long-news prompts (len>800). sample diff attached in /eval/221987 — lots of truncation and invented facts.
jordan: can we bisect quickly between model v1.3.2 and v1.3.1? if it's a model change we should pin to last good.
eva_qa: triage summary: prompt-suite N=120. failures clustered in 12 tests. repro steps: run `python eval/run_suite.py --suite prompt-suite --subset long_news --model v1.3.2`. I can kick that off now and run v1.3.1/1.3.0 for comparison. ETA ~25m.
samir_ops: FYI, release window is 6pm-9pm PT today. If we pin we'll need deploybot to keep traffic on v1.3.1 for all regions. That means reserving extra capacity for dedicated pools in eu-west for 1hr.
rachel_pm: customer impact: minor but visible on summarizer feature. We can either delay full rollout to Monday or do a pin + partial canary to 10% while we bisect. prefer minimal customer disruption tonight.
michelle: i vote pin to v1.3.1 and do a 10% canary to watch metrics for 1h. if stable, gradual roll. if further regression, rollback.
deploybot: acknowledged. waiting for human approval: `@michelle` or `@rachel_pm` to confirm pin command. :robot_face: Type `approve pin` to proceed.
rachel_pm: approve pin. please also add a note in the release notes: "pin summarizer model to v1.3.1 due to prompt-suite regression; hotfix under investigation."
jordan: started local bisect jobs. initial diffs show larger tokenization-induced changes in 1.3.2--looking at tokenizer config.
eva_qa: v1.3.1 run finished: baseline pass rate 98.2% on long_news. v1.3.2 run finished: 94.6% pass. raw diffs uploaded to /eval/221987/diffs.
samir_ops: running `deploybot pin-model --service summarizer --model v1.3.1 --scope release/2026-03-20 --maintain-canary 10%` in staging -> will mirror to production after smoke.
deploybot: executing: `pin-model summarizer v1.3.1 scope=release/2026-03-20 canary=10%`
deploybot: staging smoke: OK. canary rollout to 10% started. routing policy set to prefer v1.3.1 for release-tagged sessions.
michelle: monitoring dashboards up. setting alert thresholds tighter for hallucination metric. tagging on-call.
rachel_pm: good. please create a short JIRA (SUMM-412) for the hotfix investigation with owner @jordan and due EOD Mon.
jordan: created SUMM-412, assigned to myself. attaching tokenizer diffs and eval logs.
eva_qa: i'll run an expanded prompt battery against v1.3.1 and v1.3.2 overnight and post a summary in morning.
samir_ops: note: because of the pin, we need to cancel the auto-scaling tweak scheduled at 7pm. I'll update infra-schedule.
michelle: decision recap: pin summarizer to v1.3.1, start 10% canary, hold full promotion until bisect/hotfix. release notes updated and jira created. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
rachel_pm: will notify stakeholders and update release calendar to show partial rollout.
deploybot: canary metrics channel: #canary-metrics. will post hourly summaries for next 6h.
michelle: if canary shows degradation beyond current threshold, automatic rollback policy is `rollback-to v1.3.1` (we already pinned) so ops will flip traffic back to previous commit; samir pls confirm you have rollback playbook ready.
samir_ops: confirmed, rollback playbook ready and tested. I'll stand by during the change window.
jordan: will attempt a minimal tokenizer patch branch tomorrow, will update SUMM-412 with test results.
eva_qa: thanks all. i'll drop the morning summary and flag any additional failures.
michelle: closing thread for now. reopen if metrics spike. :lock:
